name: Frederick W. Oster Fine Violins
description: Frederick W. Oster Fine Violins. Violins, violas, cellos, bows, appraisals, and restorers. Call 215-545-1100. Monday-Friday 10am-5pm.

hero.headline: Dealer, restorers, and appraisers
hero.sub: Frederick W. Oster Fine Violins specializes in violins, violas, cellos, and bows. Appraisals and restorers on staff. Call 215-545-1100. Monday through Friday, 10 to 5.

offerings.heading: The violin family, <mark>plus the bow.</mark>
items: Violins, violas, and cellos, antique through modern, chosen for players who need the instrument in the hand.
Bows for violin, viola, cello, and bass, because the stick is half the sound.
Appraisals, certifications, and restorers when the instrument needs a written value or a real repair.

story.heading: Fine string instruments, treated as instruments
paragraphs: Oster's shop is built around the violin family. You come for a violin, a viola, a cello, or a bow, and you try it. The site still lists restorers by name.
Appraisals cover insurance, estate, and donation work. Call 215-545-1100 and book the appointment inside weekday hours, 10 to 5.

experience.heading: How a shop visit should go.
items: Call first. Fine instruments aren't a walk-up impulse for every bench.
Play the instrument in the room. A listing photo won't tell you the response.
If you need an appraisal or a restoration, say that on the call so the right person is in.

feature.heading: Appraisals and restorers in the same house
feature.text: A dealer who can also write the value and repair the crack is rarer than a pretty shop window. The bench exists for that work.

contact.heading: Book the bench <mark>visit.</mark>
contact.sub: Philadelphia. Monday-Friday 10 to 5. Confirm the street on the official site before you travel with an instrument.
